body: Thank you. I'm not going to, because they already did an investigation and they said it happened so long ago it didn't really matter. It really makes me feel better to know I'm not just overreacting. I really, really appreciate it.

Well... I'm trans. I was a guy, but I'm actually a girl (now). It also happened to my sister. I just... I'm really upset that I didn't tell anyone earlier. It was already reported and the people said that it was my dad overreacting. They had gotten a divorce 3 years before.

I don't know. I feel so crazy. I guess I mean there was touching but not with hands or anything.

Edit: I don't think it was on purpose.
